name: Bishoujo Hanafuda Kikou Michinoku Hitou Koimonogatari
original_name: 美少女花札紀行 みちのく秘湯恋物語
source:
A romance adventure game where you go around the sightseeing spots in the Tohoku region, make photos of heroines and play cards with them. All backgrounds are live-action capture with detailed commentary on various places added. This game is regarded as the origin of travelling games.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1997.htmll]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一款恋爱冒险游戏。你将在东北地区各处观光景点旅行，为女主角拍照并与她们打花札。所有背景均为实景拍摄，并附有各地详细解说。本作被视为旅行游戏的起源。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1997.htmll]vndbreview[/url]]
